body: Wire server/mob/aggro.go StatusFlags logic into MUD. isInvisible/isSneaking bools on player with 60s expiry. cast invisible/sneak commands (50 MP each). In tickAll, EvtMobAggro events are suppressed and AggroSlot cleared when the aggroed player has active Invisible/Sneak. Expires broadcast each tick.
title: S96-01: MUD Invisible/Sneak aggro block — cast invisible/sneak, EvtMobAggro intercept
